title: Pointed etale algebra category is essentially small and filtered
statement: Let R be a commutative local ring, K a chosen separable closure of its residue field, with the compatible R-algebra structure used in def-sc-ring-strict-henselization. Let P be the full subcategory of Over(CommAlgCat.of R K) consisting of objects S → K whose underlying R-algebra S is etale. Then P is essentially small in the universe of R and K and is filtered.

source.place: Tag 04GW, proof of lemma-strict-henselization-different, filteredness paragraphs; finite-presentation smallness as in the triples construction

proof.text: Identify pointed etale R-algebras with etale residue triples at the maximal ideal. For S → K recover q as its kernel and recover the residue embedding by the universal property of the fraction field of S/q. Conversely a triple supplies S → K. These constructions preserve morphisms, which are exactly R-algebra maps commuting with the pointing.

Essential smallness follows by choosing representatives of affine etale R-schemes and the set of pointings on each representative. Filteredness is transported from the triples category: R is an object, tensor products give common successors, and the iterated tensor product in Tag 04GW equalizes parallel maps. Equivalences preserve filteredness and essential smallness.

theorem pointedEtale_small_filtered
    (R K : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [Field K]
    [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) K]
    [IsSepClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) K] [Algebra R K]
    [IsScalarTower R (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) K] :
    let P : ObjectProperty (Over (CommAlgCat.of R K)) := fun X ↦ Etale R X.left
    EssentiallySmall.{u} P.FullSubcategory ∧ IsFiltered P.FullSubcategory
